case.title: Verify first-use defaults on a brand-new org (auto-approve OFF, create POs ON, vendor invoice REQUIRED)

custom.preconds: 1. A brand-new organization that has never edited Work Order settings is available. 2. Signed in as that org's Admin.
custom.steps: 1. Open /administration/settings → Work Orders tab for the new org. 2. Read the default state of Auto-approve Lines, Create Purchase Orders, and Vendor Invoice.
custom.expected: 1. Auto-approve Lines = OFF (spec default — authoritative). 2. Create Purchase Orders = ON. 3. Vendor Invoice = REQUIRED.

case.title: Verify the Save Settings button is only enabled when there is an unsaved change

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. On /administration/settings → Work Orders tab with no pending changes.
custom.steps: 1. With no changes made, look at the Save Settings button. 2. Flip a toggle and look at the Save Settings button again.
custom.expected: 1. Saving persists the settings changes. 2. Dirty-state gating (disabling Save until a change is made) is NOT required in v1 — Save being always enabled is acceptable (low-priority polish, not a blocker).

case.title: Verify new vendorless/no-PN WO parts and WO-originated POs appear and are receivable on Accept Delivery, with the vendor-missing group at the top

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A WO has a vendorless/no-PN part and a WO-originated PO reached via the Receive button.
custom.steps: 1. Open Accept Delivery for the WO. 2. Confirm the vendorless/no-PN parts appear. 3. Confirm the vendor-missing group is at the top (leading).
custom.expected: 1. New vendorless/no-PN WO parts appear and are receivable here. 2. WO-originated POs reached via the Receive button appear. 3. Vendor-missing parts sit in their own group that LEADS (appears at the top), because they need action (assign a vendor) before receiving.

case.title: Verify Accept Delivery receive gates: vendor set, missing part number entered, vendor invoice # captured

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A vendor-missing / no-PN part is in an Accept Delivery group.
custom.steps: 1. Attempt to receive without a vendor set. 2. Attempt to receive without a part number. 3. Attempt to receive without a vendor invoice number.
custom.expected: 1. Receiving is gated until a vendor is set. 2. Receiving is gated until the missing part number is entered. 3. Receiving is gated until a vendor invoice number is captured. 4. On Accept Delivery, cost is editable when $0 or missing (parity with Bulk Receive); the sell-price lock rule is unchanged.

case.title: Verify cost is editable on the Accept Delivery screen when $0 or missing (parity with Bulk Receive)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. An Accept Delivery group has a line whose cost is $0 or missing (cost is pulled from the WO/PO when available).
custom.steps: 1. Open Accept Delivery for the delivery. 2. Locate a line with a $0 or missing cost and edit the cost. 3. Confirm the quantity remains editable and the sell-price lock rule is unchanged.
custom.expected: 1. Cost is editable on Accept Delivery when $0 or missing (matching Bulk Receive / Story 8 / Story 10). 2. Quantity stays editable. 3. The sell-price lock rule is unchanged (sell locks only after the work order is invoiced/paid).

case.title: Verify the close-confirmation modal behavior (Close = closes modal only; Cancel = closes modal + returns to previous screen)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A completion modal is open.
custom.steps: 1. Trigger the close-confirmation modal. 2. Click Close (prominent/red) and observe. 3. Trigger it again and click Cancel (text link, far left) and observe.
custom.expected: 1. Close (prominent/red button) closes the confirmation modal only, discards nothing (no discard warning), and stays on the work order. 2. Cancel (text link, far left) closes the modal and returns to the previous screen. 3. Other consumers of the shared confirmation dialog keep their existing action labels.

case.title: Verify inventory cores are resolved via a line-level Ok/Not-OK control (no distinct Resolve-Cores wizard step)
case.references: SV-7698, SV-7699, SV-7870 (S3-C1 / S4-C1 / Resolve Cores handoff)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A work order has an approved inventory line that carries a core charge. 3. Auto-pick is set so the Pick step runs (or picking is otherwise required).
custom.steps: 1. Add a cored inventory part to a work order line and open the line's Parts view. 2. Confirm the part generates a Core sub-line with per-core Ok / Not-OK controls and a $ amount. 3. Click Complete Work Order and step through the completion wizard. 4. Confirm there is no distinct Resolve Cores step and completion goes Details -> Success.
custom.expected: 1. The cored part generates a Core sub-line on the line's Parts view with per-core Ok (returned, no charge) and Not-OK (keep + charge) controls and a $ amount ($0 until Not-OK). 2. The completion wizard has NO distinct Resolve Cores step; a work order whose only remaining action is core resolution completes Details -> Success. 3. Core resolution is a line-level control, not a wizard step.

case.title: Verify a work order with no cores completes with no core sub-lines and no Resolve-Cores wizard step

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A work order has no core parts.
custom.steps: 1. Click Complete Work Order. 2. Step through the completion wizard. 3. Watch for a Resolve Cores step.
custom.expected: 1. No core sub-lines appear (the work order has no cores). 2. There is no distinct Resolve Cores wizard step; completion proceeds directly Details -> Success.

case.title: Verify the core '+$ to invoice' amount is shown at the line level as a core is marked Not-OK (no Resolve-Cores wizard total)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. You are in the Resolve Cores step with multiple cores.
custom.steps: 1. On the line's Parts view, mark a Core sub-line Not-OK (keep + charge). 2. Observe the $ amount on that Core sub-line. 3. Mark the core Ok and observe the $ amount again.
custom.expected: 1. The Core sub-line shows a $ amount on the line's Parts view ($0 until it is marked Not-OK). 2. Marking the core Not-OK sets the +$ to invoice on that line. 3. There is no distinct Resolve Cores wizard step with a running total; the core $ is a line-level control.

case.title: Verify Confirm Review signs off and completes the work order directly (no distinct Reviewed holding state)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A work order is in Review with the Mark Reviewed dialog filled (VIN present).
custom.steps: 1. Click Confirm Review. 2. Observe the resulting work order state. 3. Look for a separate final 'Complete Work Order' action.
custom.expected: 1. After Confirm Review the sign-off completes and the work order moves directly Review -> Complete. 2. There is no distinct 'Reviewed' holding state and no separate final 'Complete Work Order' click.

case.title: Verify sign-off completes the work order directly (no separate final Complete) and invoicing is blocked until reviewed

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A work order is in Reviewed state (or a Review state before sign-off for the invoicing-block check).
custom.steps: 1. Before sign-off, attempt to invoice the work order. 2. Complete the review sign-off (Confirm Review). 3. Confirm the work order becomes Complete (invoice-ready).
custom.expected: 1. Invoicing is blocked until the work order is reviewed. 2. After sign-off the work order moves directly Review -> Complete (invoice-ready), with no separate final Complete Work Order click.

case.title: Verify the Mark Reviewed dialog includes VIN (required) and an optional review note field (input_review_note)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. The Mark Reviewed dialog is open.
custom.steps: 1. Open the Mark Reviewed dialog. 2. Confirm a required VIN / Serial # field (Confirm disabled until VIN entered). 3. Confirm an optional review note field is present; enter a note and Confirm.
custom.expected: 1. The Mark Reviewed dialog shows a VIN / Serial # field that is required (Confirm Reviewed is disabled until VIN is entered). 2. An optional review note field (input_review_note) is present. 3. A note can be entered and saved with the sign-off.

case.title: Verify a part can be requested with only description, quantity and sell price (part number, cost, vendor empty)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin at https://sv7301.qa.shopview.com. 2. An open work order with a line is on its Lines tab.
custom.steps: 1. Add a part to a line. 2. Enter only a description, a quantity and a sell price. 3. Leave part number, cost and vendor empty. 4. Save the part.
custom.expected: 1. The part saves successfully with only description, quantity and sell price entered. 2. Sell price is the only mandatory financial field and is validated at save (inline) — the part cannot be saved without it (not deferred to completion). 3. The part appears on the line with its description, quantity and sell price and is treated as a vendorless part downstream. 4. A sell-price-only part (missing vendor and/or cost) is orderable from the line — Order creates/joins the Vendor-Missing PO and moves it to waiting-to-receive. 5. Adding a vendorless / no-part-number part requires WO Lines: Create & Edit and See Financial Data, because the sell price is mandatory and has no catalog source.

case.title: Verify adding a part is blocked when description, quantity or sell price is missing

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. The add-part dialog is open on a work order line.
custom.steps: 1. Leave the description empty and try to save. 2. Fill description, leave quantity empty and try to save. 3. Fill quantity, leave sell price empty and try to save. 4. As a role without See Financial Data (e.g. Technician), attempt to add a vendorless / no-part-number part.
custom.expected: 1. Saving is blocked inline at save when the description is empty. 2. Saving is blocked inline at save when the quantity is empty. 3. Saving is blocked inline at save when the sell price is empty — sell price is validated at save, not deferred to completion. 4. A user without See Financial Data (for example a Technician) cannot add a vendorless / no-part-number part, because they cannot enter the mandatory sell price.

case.title: Verify the optional-invoice modal creates POs in the background and shows the count of parts to receive

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. Require Vendor Invoice Number is OFF (Optional). 3. An open work order with two approved vendor-part lines exists.
custom.steps: 1. Click Complete Work Order. 2. Read the parts-to-receive count in the modal. 3. Check that POs were created in the background for the vendor parts.
custom.expected: 1. The modal shows the number of parts waiting to receive (e.g. '2 parts waiting to receive'). 2. Background POs are created for the vendor parts (a vendorless / sell-price-only part goes on the work order's PO flagged Vendor Missing). 3. All approved-line parts are actually ordered and reach waiting-to-receive, so 'Receive Parts' always has something to receive. 4. No approved part is left in 'requested' and routed to an empty receive screen. 5. Inventory-pick status is reflected in the modal.

case.title: Verify the required-invoice wizard disables Complete until parts are received and offers no skip option

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. Require Vendor Invoice Number is ON (Required). 3. An open work order with two approved unreceived part lines exists.
custom.steps: 1. Click Complete Work Order. 2. Observe the primary CTA state. 3. Look for a 'Complete without receiving' option.
custom.expected: 1. The wizard shows a Receive step ('2 parts waiting to receive'). 2. The primary Complete Work Order CTA is DISABLED until all parts are received. 3. There is NO 'Complete without receiving' option. 4. Approved sell-price-only parts (missing vendor and/or cost) are ordered too and reach waiting-to-receive before the receive gate — no approved part is left in 'requested' with nothing to receive.

case.title: Verify the required-invoice receive round-trip returns to the modal and enables Complete once all received

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. You are in the required-invoice completion wizard with unreceived parts.
custom.steps: 1. Click Receive Parts. 2. On the shared Accept Delivery page, enter qty, tax, date, note and vendor invoice # per vendor and receive all parts. 3. Click Back to Work Order (or finish). 4. Observe the completion modal CTA, then click Complete Work Order.
custom.expected: 1. The receive page collects qty, tax, date, note and invoice # per vendor. 2. On return, once all parts are received the Complete Work Order CTA is enabled. 3. Completing shows the Success screen. 4. Sell-price-only parts were ordered to waiting-to-receive, so they appear in the receive round-trip and are not left in 'requested'.

case.title: Verify inline part-number field-locking rules match the receive-screen rules (sell locks after invoiced/paid)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. A part on an invoiced/paid WO and a part on an open WO are available.
custom.steps: 1. On the open WO part, confirm qty/cost/sell are editable. 2. On the invoiced/paid WO part, confirm sell is locked and cost is editable.
custom.expected: 1. Open work order: quantity, cost and sell are editable. 2. Invoiced/paid work order: sell is locked (lock icon + tooltip), only cost editable. 3. The inline part-number field rules apply with parity across BOTH the Bulk Receive page AND the single / Accept-Delivery receive screen. 4. Cost is editable when $0 or missing on either receive surface.

case.title: Verify field editability and locking on Bulk Receive (qty and cost editable; sell locks after WO invoiced/paid)

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin. 2. The Bulk Receive page has a PO whose WO is NOT yet invoiced/paid, and another whose WO IS invoiced/paid.
custom.steps: 1. On the not-yet-invoiced PO, edit quantity, cost and sell. 2. On the invoiced/paid PO, try to edit sell. 3. Hover the locked sell field.
custom.expected: 1. Quantity and cost are editable; sell is editable while the work order is not invoiced/paid. 2. After the work order is invoiced/paid, sell is locked with a lock icon and tooltip 'Locked — this part is already invoiced or paid'. 3. After locking, only cost remains editable. 4. The field rules have parity with the Accept-Delivery receive screen; cost is editable when $0 or missing on either surface.

case.title: Verify a sell-price-only part is orderable from the line's Order action, joins the Vendor-Missing PO and moves to waiting-to-receive

custom.preconds: 1. Signed in as Admin at https://sv7301.qa.shopview.com. 2. An open work order has a sell-price-only line part (sell price set; vendor and/or cost missing; part number empty).
custom.steps: 1. On the line, use the Order action for the sell-price-only part. 2. Open the PO list at /parts/orders and find the work order's PO. 3. Confirm the part's status.
custom.expected: 1. Ordering from the line creates or joins the work order's Vendor-Missing PO (no separate dummy PO). 2. The part moves from 'requested' to 'waiting-to-receive' without completing the work order. 3. At receive, a vendor and part number are still required (cost editable — Story 10).
